newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland sells PLN 65 mln 10-yr floating bonds.
newsitem.headline: Poland sells PLN 65 mln 10-yr floating bonds.

text.p: Poland sold 65 million zlotys of 10-year floating bonds after investors bid for 68 million, the central bank said.
The minimum price at the 600 million zloty primary auction was 98.53, down from 98.60 at the last tender on April 8. The average price was 98.60, also down from the previous 99.05.
The value date for the tender is July 17, 1997, and the bonds mature on July 18, 2007.
